items.title: Corning, Lumentum And Applied Optoelectronics Shares Popping To End The Week
items.summary: Optics stocks are surging into the weekend with no confirmed catalyst behind the move, while Broadcom sells off sharply even as the broader market hits record highs. The divergence points to a trade worth understanding before Monday.

items.title: Stock Market Hits Highs; Cisco, Lumentum, Super Micro, Sandisk Key Movers: Weekly Review
items.summary: The stock market cleared a tight range, with the S&P 500 and Russell 2000 hitting new highs. Lumentum, Cisco, Super Micro, Sandisk were key movers.

items.title: Reddit is Up 11% Premarket After S&P 500 Addition. Here’s How Other New S&P 500 Stocks Performed.
items.summary: Index funds may be forced to buy nearly three times Reddit's average daily trading volume after its S&P 500 announcement, but a look at the last twelve additions to the benchmark tells a very different story about what happens next.

items.title: Dow Jones Futures: Sandisk, Memory Stocks Extend Gains; Applied Materials Tumbles
items.summary: The S&P 500 hits a new high after a constructive pause. Workday and Sandisk lifted software and memory plays. Applied Materials fell late on earnings.

items.title: What Are Wall Street Analysts' Target Price for Coherent Stock?
items.summary: Coherent has significantly outperformed the broader market, while analysts remain strongly optimistic about its future growth prospects.

items.title: Why Coherent Stock Jumped Before Its Own Results Landed
items.summary: The gain was set before the results crossed, and its optical peers rose with it.

items.title: Sandisk, Cisco, Micron, Ondas, Coherent, Cerebras, and More Stocks That Explain Today’s Market
items.summary: Stocks rose Thursday following softer-than-expected wholesale inflation data for July and growing confidence that the Federal Reserve won’t raise interest rates in September.  The company added that adjusted gross margins should stabilize at around 80% over that period, with an adjusted free-cash-flow margin of about 50%.  Cisco Systems  fell 8.4% even after the tech hardware company beat earnings and revenue estimates for its fiscal fourth quarter.

items.title: Coherent Stock Reverses Higher as AI Optics Forecast Beats Estimates
items.summary: Coherent recovered from an early decline as accelerating data-center sales and stronger margins reinforced its role in AI connectivity.
